decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p class="MsoNormal">The development shall not progress beyond damp proof course
until details of the provision of green/biodiverse roofs and living wall within
the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local
Planning Authority. The details to be submitted shall comprise:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">a) identification of the roof areas to be used for the
provision of green/biodiverse roofs;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">b) details of the planting and substrate to be used,
including roof build up, plant species/mix(es) schedule which should include at
least 20 native flower species, plans and sections as appropriate; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">c) details of the maintenance including irrigation.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>











</p><p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
details so agreed and shall be retained and maintained as such thereafter.<o:p></o:p></p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Design and Access statement, 175 - D – 12D, 175 - D – 11D, 175 - D – 10E, 175 - D – 09E, 175 - D – 08D, 175 - D – 06B, 175 - D – 05C, 175 - D – 04C, 175 - D – 03C, 175- D– 02C, 175&nbsp;<div>- D - 01A&nbsp; &nbsp;</div><div>&nbsp;&nbsp;</div>
